speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Amoxicillin-Allergic Morbilliform Rash (Drug Eruption) with transient arthralgia. The normal CBC, liver tests, and IgE levels, combined with the specific reaction to amoxicillin and the absence of a "slapped cheek" pattern, rule out Erythema Infectiosum (Parvovirus B19) and severe serum sickness, indicating a common benign hypersensitivity reaction to the antibiotic.
